division.bro.official.pc-2018-42.note: Season 42 ran Update 42.1 through 42.3. End is when PC servers go down for the 43.1 maintenance (2026-09-10 00:00 UTC) -- the last moment it can be played. Servers return ~8.5 h later, at 08:30 UTC, and Update 43.1 opens Season 43.

division.bro.official.pc-2018-43.note: Start is official: Update 43.1 becomes available when the maintenance completes. End is a guess -- KRAFTON has not announced one -- carried over from Season 42's measured 85 days, so the homepage prints it with a tilde. Replace it when 43.3's schedule is published.
